events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/kernel/sched/schedule_api/src/test_sched_timeslice_and_lock.c` where `test_sleep_cooperative` erroneously called `k_yield()` instead of `k_sleep(K_MSEC(100))`. With `k_yield()`, the cooperative main thread (priority -1) remained ready and prevented the lower-priority thread (priority 0) from executing; calling `k_sleep(K_MSEC(100))` places the main thread in the timeout queue so all ready threads execute as expected.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
